message.content: No, Li Hua did not agree to go out for dinner immediately upon Wolfgang's initial invitation. Wolfgang first suggested a dinner outing, but Li Hua responded that he was "super busy lately" and suggested doing something low-key instead, possibly a movie or hanging out at a cafe. This indicates that Li Hua needed more time to decide and preferred a less demanding activity. Li Hua did eventually agree to meet Wolfgang at 6 PM for dinner, showing that he was willing to go out for a meal but needed more time to prepare.
